entities.name: Keldon Twilight
entities.description: Event in Keld in 4205 AR where the dead rose under Phyrexian necromancy.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Lord of Skyshroud allied with Astor.

entities.name: Doyenne Tajamin
entities.description: Keldon warrior-priestess who wielded the Cudgel of Keld.

entities.name: Cudgel of Keld
entities.description: Sacred relic that burned and melted the glacier.

entities.name: Kradak the Unyielding
entities.description: First lord of Keld and reputed first captain of the Argosy.

entities.name: Lin Sivvi
entities.description: Of the Vec; saved aboard Argosy.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Tore open the fabric of Dominaria.

events.summary: Eladamri and Astor's armies make a stand against the Phyrexians at the Keldon Necropolis.
events.quote: Together, their armies of elves and Keldons made a desperate stand against the advancing Phyrexian forces

events.summary: Phyrexian necromancy raises Keldon dead as thralls.
events.quote: the dead of Keld did indeed rise

events.summary: Tajamin strikes a risen hero and the cudgel catches fire.
events.quote: was shocked to feel the cudgel catch fire beneath her fingers

events.summary: Tajamin hurls the cudgel down, melting the glacier and flooding the battlefield.
events.quote: The cudgel's divine heat shattered the ice, melting the glacier in a violent surge of scalding water.

events.summary: The Golden Argosy arrives and rescues survivors.
events.quote: The ship’s crew pulled many survivors

events.summary: Eladamri and Sivvi sail on toward the battle at Urborg.
events.quote: carrying them toward the final, desperate battle at Urborg

relations.quote: had forged a fragile alliance with Warlord Astor
first captained by Kradak the Unyielding, the first lord of Keld
the people of Keld faced the darkest hour
